title: Arrangements for Woody Herman
summary: Woody never played most of what he wrote.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: You also did some things for Woody Herman; right?
I did a lot of things for Woody but he never played them either. I don't really know why that was.
It's the first record with that dixieland band, wasn't it?
No, that was the one with Ralph Burns and (inaudible) Harris.
Yes, Stan wasn't there, Zoot wasn't there?
No; Stan was there later. That was the so-called (inaudible).
The one that's called the first heard, I guess was '44, '45.
